title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — October 24, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B4.1)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.0 (Peaked October 24, 2026 at 06:44 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 401 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.67)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Things are getting energetic up there! 📡🔌🚀

Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
